title: workflow: the vibe-recipe — name one project lemma per proof step, then solve one-by-one
intent: Record the vibe-recipe decomposition workflow as realized for the Gaussian log-Sobolev inequality: the prompt (the skill-text site) states the target theorem once and lays the proof out as seven named steps, one project lemma per step, and the glue assembles gaussian_logSobolev_W12_real from those lemmas — a smooth compact-support approximation, L^2 and L^1 convergence transfer, the compact-support LSI, gradient convergence and an a.e.-subsequence extraction — each proved separately and solved one-by-one.
also_known_as: one named lemma per proof step

parent.name: gaussian_logSobolev_W12_real
parent.statement:
theorem gaussian_logSobolev_W12_real {f : ℝ → ℝ}
    (hf : MemW12GaussianReal f (gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf_grad_cont : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x)) :
    LogSobolev.entropy GaussianPoincare.stdGaussianMeasure (fun x => (f x)^2) ≤
      2 * ∫ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖^2 ∂GaussianPoincare.stdGaussianMeasure

children.name: exists_smooth_compactSupport_seq_tendsto_real
children.statement:
theorem exists_smooth_compactSupport_seq_tendsto_real (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : MemW12GaussianReal f (gaussianReal 0 1))
    (hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ f) (hf_grad_cont : Continuous (fun x => fderiv ℝ f x)) :
    ∃ g : ℕ → (ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (g k)) ∧
      (∀ k, HasCompactSupport (g k)) ∧
      Tendsto (fun k => GaussianSobolevNormSqReal (f - g k) (gaussianReal 0 1)) atTop (nhds 0)
children.closed_by: obtain a sequence g' from GaussianSobolev.exists_smooth_compactSupport_seq_tendsto on the E 1 push-forward f' (toE1Fun f), then use fun k => fromE1Fun (g' k) (lines 839-842)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: For f : R -> R in the 1D Gaussian Sobolev class (MemW12GaussianReal f (gaussianReal 0 1), Differentiable f, Continuous (fderiv f)), there is a sequence g of smooth compactly-supported functions with GaussianSobolevNormSqReal (f - g k) (gaussianReal 0 1) -> 0.

lemma tendsto_eLpNorm_sub_of_sobolev (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (h_tend : Tendsto (fun k => GaussianSobolevNormSqReal (f - g k) μ) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => eLpNorm (f - g k) 2 μ) atTop (nhds 0)
children.closed_by: tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le bounding eLpNorm (f - g k) 2 mu ^ 2 by GaussianSobolevNormSqReal, then ENNReal.tendsto_nhds_zero (lines 108-129)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: If GaussianSobolevNormSqReal (f - g k) mu -> 0 then eLpNorm (f - g k) 2 mu -> 0: Sobolev-norm convergence implies L^2 convergence.

children.name: tendsto_eLpNorm_sq_sub_of_tendsto_L2
children.statement:
lemma tendsto_eLpNorm_sq_sub_of_tendsto_L2
    (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hf_cont : Continuous f) (hg_cont : ∀ k, Continuous (g k))
    (hf_mem : MemLp f 2 μ)
    (h_tend : Tendsto (fun k => eLpNorm (f - g k) 2 μ) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => eLpNorm (fun x => (g k x)^2 - (f x)^2) (1 : ENNReal) μ) atTop (nhds 0)
children.closed_by: Holder via eLpNorm_le_eLpNorm_mul_eLpNorm_of_nnnorm, then eLpNorm_add_le and tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' (lines 138-247)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: If f and each g k are continuous, f is in L^2, and eLpNorm (f - g k) 2 mu -> 0, then eLpNorm ((g k)^2 - f^2) 1 mu -> 0: L^2 convergence implies L^1 convergence of the pointwise squares, via Holder.

children.name: gaussian_logSobolev_CompSmo_fderiv
children.statement:
theorem gaussian_logSobolev_CompSmo_fderiv {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : CompactlySupportedSmooth f) :
    LogSobolev.entropy stdGaussianMeasure (fun x => (f x)^2) ≤
    2 * ∫ x, ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖^2 ∂stdGaussianMeasure
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: For compactly-supported smooth f, LogSobolev.entropy stdGaussianMeasure (x |-> (f x)^2) <= 2 * integral of |fderiv f x|^2 over stdGaussianMeasure: the compact-support Gaussian LSI in fderiv form.

children.name: tendsto_eLpNorm_fderiv_sub_of_sobolev
children.statement:
lemma tendsto_eLpNorm_fderiv_sub_of_sobolev (f : ℝ → ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (μ : Measure ℝ)
    (hf_diff : Differentiable ℝ f) (hg_diff : ∀ k, Differentiable ℝ (g k))
    (h_tend : Tendsto (fun k => GaussianSobolevNormSqReal (f - g k) μ) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun k => eLpNorm (fun x => ‖fderiv ℝ f x - fderiv ℝ (g k) x‖) 2 μ)
      atTop (nhds 0)

children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: If f and each g k are differentiable and GaussianSobolevNormSqReal (f - g k) mu -> 0, then eLpNorm (|fderiv f x - fderiv (g k) x|) 2 mu -> 0: Sobolev convergence implies L^2 convergence of gradients.

children.name: exists_seq_tendsto_ae_of_tendsto_eLpNorm_one
children.statement:
theorem exists_seq_tendsto_ae_of_tendsto_eLpNorm_one
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] {f : ℕ → α → E} {g : α → E}
    (hf : ∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) mu)
    (hg : AEStronglyMeasurable g mu)
    (hfg : Tendsto (fun n => eLpNorm (f n - g) (1 : ENNReal) mu) atTop (nhds 0)) :
    ∃ ns : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono ns ∧
      ∀ᵐ x ∂mu, Tendsto (fun i => f (ns i) x) atTop (nhds (g x))
children.closed_by: tendstoInMeasure_of_tendsto_eLpNorm gives convergence in measure, then exists_seq_tendsto_ae (lines 22-24)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: For AEStronglyMeasurable f n and g, if eLpNorm (f n - g) 1 mu -> 0 then some strictly monotone ns has f (ns i) -> g a.e.: L^1 convergence yields an a.e.-convergent subsequence.

applicability.goal_shape: A theorem proved by a scripted passage to the limit: Ent_γ(f^2) ≤ 2 * ∫ ‖fderiv f‖^2 dγ for f ∈ W^{1,2}(γ) (OneDimGLSI.lean lines 410-419), obtained by approximating f by smooth compactly-supported g_k, applying the known compact-support LSI to each g_k, and taking liminf via Fatou's lemma and lower semicontinuity of entropy (lines 420-939).
applicability.use_when: The target theorem can be pre-planned as a handful of named proof steps (approximation, convergence transfer, a known special case, a subsequence/liminf argument), and each step is small enough to state and prove as its own named project lemma within one agent context window (~300 lines). The move is an agent prompt: state the target once, attach each step to a named lemma before any tactic is written, then prove them one-by-one (EXAMPLE_INSTRUCTIONS.md lines 108-326).
applicability.avoid_when: The steps do not separate into named lemmas (the glue is one monolithic tactic block), a step is too large for one context window and cannot be split further, or the glue needs a lemma the prompt names but never actually proves. Here tendsto_integral_norm_fderiv_sq_of_sobolev is named in Step 6 (EXAMPLE_INSTRUCTIONS.md line 295) but the glue never cites it — it inlines the same conclusion in place (OneDimGLSI.lean lines 492-562).

consequences: The glue must discharge each child's hypotheses in order: exists_smooth_compactSupport_seq_tendsto_real delivers hg_smooth/hg_supp/h_sob_tend (line 424); tendsto_eLpNorm_sub_of_sobolev consumes h_sob_tend (line 428); tendsto_eLpNorm_sq_sub_of_tendsto_L2 needs continuity and MemLp of f plus the L^2 convergence (line 435); gaussian_logSobolev_CompSmo_fderiv needs CompactlySupportedSmooth (g k), which the glue rebuilds from hg_smooth/hg_supp (lines 476-481); tendsto_eLpNorm_fderiv_sub_of_sobolev needs differentiability of f and each g k plus h_sob_tend (line 531); exists_seq_tendsto_ae_of_tendsto_eLpNorm_one needs the L^1 convergence of qk - q (line 670). The lemmas therefore close only bottom-up. A failure mode is a planned lemma the realization does not cite: the prompt names tendsto_integral_norm_fderiv_sq_of_sobolev (Step 6) but the glue re-derives its conclusion in place via TaylorBound.deriv_bounded_of_compactlySupported and tendsto_eLpNorm_fderiv_sub_of_sobolev (lines 492-562), so the plan and the glue diverge. Another is a side condition delivered only by a later step (the L^1 convergence of squares needs the L^2 convergence first), which breaks the one-by-one order if the steps are attempted top-down.
